communication-play-01-project-impact.title: Initial Efficacy of Project ImPACT: A Parent-Mediated Social Communication Intervention for Young Children with ASD
communication-play-01-project-impact.limitation: Eight parent-child pairs; useful for design context, not broad causal claims.

communication-play-02-more-than-words.title: A randomized controlled trial of Hanen’s More Than Words in toddlers with early autism symptoms
communication-play-02-more-than-words.limitation: Modest toddler sample; no significant overall child-outcome effect, and subgroup findings need replication.

communication-play-03-play-review.title: Play-based interventions to support social and communication development in autistic children aged 2–8 years: A scoping review
communication-play-03-play-review.limitation: Maps diverse approaches but does not appraise study quality or synthesize efficacy.

visual-transitions-01-home-community-sco.title: Visual supports at home and in the community for individuals with autism spectrum disorders: A scoping review
visual-transitions-01-home-community-sco.limitation: Home evidence is limited and heterogeneous; emphasizes fit, accessibility, participation, and training.

visual-transitions-02-teacch-review.title: The effectiveness of TEACCH-based interventions in improving adaptive skills in children with autism spectrum disorders: a systematic review and meta-analysis
visual-transitions-02-teacch-review.limitation: Interventions and settings varied; authors note study-quality, reporting, and publication-bias limitations.

visual-transitions-03-transition-study.title: Separate and combined effects of visual schedules and extinction plus differential reinforcement on problem behavior occasioned by transitions
visual-transitions-03-transition-study.limitation: Two participants in a narrow treatment context; visual schedules alone did not reduce transition-related behavior.

parent-coaching-01-rubi-rct.title: Effect of parent training vs parent education on behavioral problems in children with autism spectrum disorder: a randomized clinical trial
parent-coaching-01-rubi-rct.limitation: Enrolled children had disruptive behavior; parent-rated outcome differences did not meet prespecified minimal clinically important differences.

parent-coaching-02-stepping-stones-tripl.title: Stepping Stones Triple P: an RCT of a parenting program with parents of a child diagnosed with an autism spectrum disorder
parent-coaching-02-stepping-stones-tripl.limitation: Small sample of 59 families; not evidence that a generic activity template reproduces a branded program.

parent-coaching-03-parent-implemented-fc.title: A Systematic Review of Parent-Implemented Functional Communication Training for Children With ASD
parent-coaching-03-parent-implemented-fc.limitation: Included intervention studies had fidelity, sustainability, and access gaps; not equivalent to unsupervised generic practice.

parent-coaching-04-assent-safety-review.title: Assent in applied behaviour analysis and positive behaviour support: ethical considerations and practical recommendations
parent-coaching-04-assent-safety-review.limitation: Ethical/practice guidance, not a controlled efficacy or safety trial.
